class.name: isaac_ros_cumotion_controllers/BimanualIkController
class.description: Bimanual IK controller using cuMotion RMPflow. Subscribes to ~/reference_pose (PoseArray) for two end-effector targets and writes position, velocity, and effort commands to hardware interfaces via Pinocchio RNEA feedforward.

class.name: isaac_ros_cumotion_controllers/IkController
class.description: Single-arm IK controller using cuMotion RMPflow. Subscribes to ~/reference_pose (PoseStamped) for one end-effector target, runs an open-loop integrator continuously low-pass synced to hardware state, and writes position, velocity, effort, kp, and kd commands per joint. kp / kd are written as NaN so that a downstream isaac_ros_deploy SafetyController defers to its per-joint fallback gains; the controller addresses the SafetyController's _raw reference interfaces by setting command_prefix=<safety_controller_name> and command_suffix=_raw. Effort is Pinocchio RNEA feedforward torque. Reference poses with non-finite components or the origin+identity sentinel are rejected.
